r.name: r (VPD)
r.definition: Share of the fine-tune's log-odds gain that comes from changed causal importances with the original subcomponents' weights held fixed.

ratio.name: Stand-in ratio (VPD)
ratio.definition: The gain reached when the original causal importances stand in for the original weights, over the whole gain.

steering.name: Steering
steering.definition: One mean residual shift per block, added to the original model; share of the gain it reaches.

neuron_patch.name: Neuron patching
neuron_patch.definition: The top neurons by activation shift take the fine-tuned activations; share of the gain, and how many neurons reach half.

prompting.name: Prompting
prompting.definition: The original model shown demonstrations of the map in context; share of the gain reached.

pruning.name: Pruning revival
pruning.definition: Jain et al.'s Algorithm 3: remove the units that matter most to the fine-tuned behaviour; share of the old behaviour that returns.

reverse.name: Reverse fine-tuning
reverse.definition: Fine-tune back toward the old behaviour; how fast it returns.

readout_64.name: Readout, 64 values
readout_64.definition: A linear readout over the pair's values, trained on Pile text; share of the gain lost when its direction is removed.

readout_full.name: Readout, whole vocabulary
readout_full.definition: The same with a linear readout over every token.

sparsity.name: Neuron sparsity
sparsity.definition: Five counts of how few neurons the update or its activation shift sits on.

labeller.name: Recipe or size
labeller.definition: A labeller that reads only the learning rate, the steps or the size of the weight change.

probe.name: Answer probe
probe.definition: A probe on the original model's residual that reads only which answers the state gives.
